richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tadipatri

c: Tadipatri, in Anantapur district, is one of the driest parts of Andhra Pradesh, and the town is known for its stone and cement industries. Low rainfall, high heat and dust from quarries all affect outdoor equipment. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tadipatri for schools, colleges, municipal parks and the staff colonies of local industries. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 740 km away.

The town also has old temples on the Penna river that draw visitors, and its parks are used by families in the cooler evening hours. A small open gym in one of these spaces gives residents free daily exercise. We plan the set from your photos, send a layout drawing and install with our team or a dealer in south India.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines need the least maintenance in a dusty town?
items.a: Static machines with no bearings, such as parallel bars and pull-up stations. Machines with moving parts are fine too, but need regular wiping and occasional bearing checks.

items.q: Can industrial staff colonies order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Many industries add an open gym in their staff colony or near the canteen. Share the space and number of users for a layout drawing and quote.

items.q: What warranty covers the moving parts?
items.a: Bearings, springs and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years.
